english.title: Harassment of a person in his home

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Serious Organised Crime and Police Act 2005

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(I) References regarding the intention of the offenders "presence" are references to his presence either alone or together with that of any other persons who are also present.
(ii) This offence applies from 29th June 2026 due to changes made by the Crime and Policing Act 2026. For the offence applying before this date, see H6639.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level 4 on the standard scale. In relation to an offence committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the ‘maximum term for summary offences’ reference is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment, for offences committed after that section comes in to force, the reference is to be read as 51 weeks imprisonment. Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
